about_the_game:
Heavy Burden VR is an atmospheric first-person platformer in virtual reality, where you drag a heavy stone through the sandy ruins of an ancient world, overcoming obstacles and the philosophical questions of existence. The game is inspired by Camus’ ideas about humanity’s struggle with the absurd and the endless search for meaning.

Story
You are a nameless hero, awakening among ruins where eternity is frozen in stone and marble. Your task is to carry the stone to a burning brazier. But why? What will it bring? And who set this goal before you? Throughout the game, the character encounters symbols and voices representing two opposing views: traditional religious faith and the philosophy of the absurd, where meaning is not given but chosen. The question is not what awaits at the end of the path — but why walk it at all.

Gameplay
Each level is a challenge in which the player must drag the stone from the starting point to the brazier at the end of the route. The stone is heavy: it hinders movement, limits jumps, and requires effort and attention. Gameplay is built on interaction with the environment, platforming puzzles, and precise spatial movement. VR mode enhances immersion — you feel the burden’s weight and physically interact with the world.

Game Features
● Immersive VR controls — realistic interaction with the stone through hand and body movement
● Atmosphere of the ancient world — low-poly surfaces combined with detailed ruins of Greek architecture
● Philosophical depth — inspired by the works of Albert Camus, contrasting absurdism with traditional concepts of faith
● Multiple endings — the outcome depends on the path you choose
● Deep atmosphere — sound design and music emphasize the sense of solitude and struggle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel core i5-9xxx
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Oculus Touch, Valve Index.

  • Processor: Intel core i5-10xxx
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Oculus Touch, Valve Index.
